note: Stephen Strasburg's AAA debut — the most hyped pitching prospect in years before he'd thrown a single MLB pitch. He went 6 innings, 0 ER, 6 Ks. He made his MLB debut three days later.
Bryce Harper's first game at the AAA level, just 19 years old. He was called up to the majors less than two weeks later.

An ALCS preview in May. These two teams would meet in the ALCS three times over the next six years (2017, 2019, 2022), with Houston winning each time. McCullers Jr. dominated for 6 innings, and McCann — a former Yankee — hit a 3-run homer off Montgomery to put it away.

The Guardians' home opener — the first game under the new name at Progressive Field, with Tom Hanks throwing out the first pitch. Carlos Rodón, who had no-hit this very franchise a year earlier as a White Sox, came back and beat them again.
Stephen Strasburg's final rehab start — he never pitched in the majors again after this, ultimately retiring in 2023 due to nerve damage.

Albert Pujols hit home run #697 to pass Alex Rodriguez for 4th all time in this game, part of his remarkable final-season chase to 700. Mitch Keller was dealing on the other side — 7 hitless innings, 0 ER — before the Pirates bullpen gave it all back in the 9th. STL won 4-3.
Julio Rodríguez hit a tiebreaking 2-run homer in the 9th to send the Guardians crowd home unhappy. José Ramírez was his usual self.

The Rays were 10-0 entering this game and won to go 11-0 — part of a 13-0 start that tied the modern MLB record. McClanahan struck out 9. Tampa outscored opponents 101-30 during the streak and would finish the season with the best record in the AL.

Ohtani's first season as a Dodger after the historic $700M deal — he was DH-only in 2024 while recovering from TJ surgery, but that didn't stop him: he hit a 473-foot homer in this game to become the first NL player with 30 HRs on the season. Freeman also went deep. Kenley Jansen makes an appearance agains his former team.
Lucas Giolito was brilliant — 7 innings, 0 ER, 5 Ks at Fenway.

Rich Hill, 45 years old, was called up to the majors mid-game for what turned out to be the final appearance of his career. He retired at the end of the season — one of the great journeyman stories in modern baseball.
Shane Bieber's rehab start as he works his way back from Tommy John surgery.
Ronald Acuña Jr. back in the lineup after his ACL comeback year.
